title: Resume planning-capped jobs from the kept plan; report planning cost per
summary: When planning stops at the three-round cap, keep the round-3 plan and the critic's findings with the job. `athena retry` of such a job seeds the planner with them (one revision round, then the critic) instead of a fresh plan. Retries of jobs stopped for any other reason still plan fresh. `athena status` reports planning rounds and planning cost per landed job from records. Audience: the Athena operator.

defaults_applied.how: New tests for resume, fresh retry, and status; fmt, clippy -D warnings and test suite must pass.
Criteria check the planner input and the critic's first-round input, not just that fields exist.
Status measure reports rounds and cost per landed job from records.
One focused change in the listed files.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: stop wasting planning spend when a plan hits the round cap with only small findings left. Audience: the Athena operator.

'Before and after' in status is read as a split of landed jobs by whether the planning-resume change applied. The split is a cutover point derived from records, and the values are labeled as measured.
Kept plan and findings may need a new typed record in athena-data; if existing records already hold the plan and critique, no new variant is added.
If the retried plan's base or request changed, resume still applies, since only planning-stopped jobs qualify.
The default retry behavior for non-planning stops is unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test stops a job at the planning cap with a fixture critic. `athena retry` of it gives the planner the kept round-3 plan and the critic's findings. The first critic round of the retry sees the revised plan, and the retry does only one revision round before the critic. Run: cargo test --locked (named test).
A test shows a retry of a job that stopped for any other reason (e.g. timeout, verification failure) still starts the planner with a fresh plan and receives no kept plan. Run: cargo test --locked.

athena status prints planning rounds and planning cost per landed job, computed from job records. A test with fixture records asserts the printed numbers, including a before/after split. Run: cargo test --locked.
The kept plan and findings are stored with the job as records, with no secrets or personal data.
cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked all exit 0.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing resumable planning stops and the new status measure.

out_of_scope: Changing how the critic grades findings
Backfilling records for old jobs beyond computing the measure from existing records
departures: Touches the run loop, retry seeding, and status together, so cost and time are above the reference; the risk of a planning stop is higher.
urgent_reason: Retrying from the kept plan avoids redoing the whole reading and plan after a round-3 stop, which cuts repeated planning cost and redo-work retries (three jobs today).
